signal_vs_staking.rule: signal and staking are separate columns and separate scores; rank_signal is computed from signal_score only. A lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal because equity, drawdown and staking_score are structurally absent from the ranking key.
signal_vs_staking.signal_score: z = (p_hat - p_break) / sqrt(p_hat(1-p_hat)/n) over decided bets; stake-independent; blank when n = 0 (unmeasured is not zero)
signal_vs_staking.rank_signal: the leaderboard rank; ties break on larger n, then id
signal_vs_staking.staking_score: realized units per decided bet; informational only, never a rank input
signal_vs_staking.max_drawdown_units: worst peak-to-trough of that path; informational only
